tbesh_html:
1) to depart, remove
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to depart
1a2) to remove
1a3) to be removed (of inanimate objects)
1b) (Hiphil) to remove, depart

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to withdraw (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitive or transitive)
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root (perhaps rather the same as H4184 (מוּשׁ) through the idea of receding by contact);
strongs_1890.kjv_def: cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.
